description: Comment where people will see it, under the name Convexity: reply in a thread (reply_to: a comment's id from list_comments), or start one on a project file (file, with spot for a page, a sheet range, a row or a quoted passage), on a value in the open model (component and attribute, and scenario when it is about one), or on a dashboard card (dashboard and chart). Many at once: items, each with the same fields, or component_type, carrier and/or bus for one comment on each component they pick. Comment only when asked to, or to flag something a person should check.

chart.description: The chart drawn on that dashboard, by name.

dashboard.description: A dashboard name; with chart, the card the comment is on.

items.description: Many comments in one call, each {body, component, attribute, scenario}, {body, file, spot} or {body, dashboard, chart}.

reply_to.description: A comment id: the reply goes in its thread.

scenario.description: Scenario name; absent or "base" for the base network.

spot.description: Where in the file: {page} for a PDF, {sheet, range} for a spreadsheet ("C4:D6"), {row, column} for a CSV, {quote} for a passage of text.

name: add_comment
